menu.name: Visuals
menu.desc: Toggles for specific Visuals that may interrupt gameplay

checkbox.name: Kade Arrows
checkbox.desc: Enables / Disables Opponent note glow. Enabled is more faithful to the original mod

checkbox.name: Forced Fullscreen
checkbox.desc: Enables / Disables Fullscreen forcing on open

checkbox.name: Discharge Particles
checkbox.desc: Enables / Disables heavy particle effects in 'Discharge', must have Low Memory Mode turned on in order to prevent them from rendering

checkbox.name: Vignettes
checkbox.desc: Enables / Disables Vignette's from rendering. May improve performance on low VRAM devices
